samples.question: The gold-ringed arrow on the START board shows the pilot's cell and heading. Read the command tiles in row order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom. A cyan curved arrow turns the pilot 90 degrees clockwise without moving. A coral chevron moves the pilot one cell forward; crossing an edge wraps to the opposite edge of the 3 by 3 board. Which lettered cell contains the pilot after every command?
